👂 NEW: Researchers simulated a #classical vocal competition in a concert hall, recording 22 singers performing the same a cappella song before five expert judges. 

Higher overall scores tracked with better vibrato, resonance, and expressiveness, plus stronger energy in the 2-4 kHz range, while diction, timbre, intonation, and louder volume did not predict scores.
